# Pooler

> Pooler is a local protocol runtime and pooling proxy by Coder Company. It connects AI coding tools (Cursor, Devin, Factory Droid, Claude Code, and AI SDKs) to AI subscriptions (ChatGPT / Codex) and model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok). It translates request formats, pools multiple accounts to bypass rate limits, stores credentials in encrypted SQLite, and provides a local web dashboard for monitoring requests.

Repository: https://github.com/coder-company/pooler
Agent Index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coder-company/pooler/main/llms.txt

## Agent Initiation Prompt (Give This to Your Agent)

Paste this prompt into your coding agent (Cursor, Devin, Claude Code, Factory Droid) in any workspace to start autonomous setup:

```text
Set up and configure Pooler for this workspace from https://github.com/coder-company/pooler:
1. First, ask me using your interactive question tool:
   - Which coding tool/agent I am using (Cursor, Devin, Factory Droid, Claude Code / Codex, or General SDK/Gateway).
   - What credentials/subscriptions I want to connect (ChatGPT / Codex subscription via device OAuth, Google Gemini OAuth, Anthropic Claude API key, OpenAI API key, xAI Grok, or Custom).
   - Whether I want multi-account pooling with automatic rate-limit failover.
   - What specific models or reasoning settings I want enabled (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-7-sonnet, gemini-2.5-pro, o3-mini with high reasoning).
2. Fetch documentation and recipes from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coder-company/pooler/main/llms.txt or inspect the repository at https://github.com/coder-company/pooler.
3. Install the Pooler binary if not already present:
   `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coder-company/pooler/main/install.sh | bash`
4. Initialize the starter workspace using `pooler init --output ./pooler-starter`.
5. Apply the required preset or configuration with secure secret references (env:, file:, or keyring:).
6. Guide me through authentication (such as running `pooler auth login openai --method device-code` for Codex subscriptions or setting environment variables).
7. Run `pooler check` and `pooler preflight` to verify setup without billable inference.
8. Start the server and confirm the exact local base URL for my coding tool.
```

## Agent Protocol & Task Recipes

- [Agent-Native Setup Guide](docs/agent-native.md): Detailed 6-step autonomous protocol for agents.
- [Connect Codex Subscription](docs/agent-native.md#step-4-authentication--credential-storage): Authenticate ChatGPT / Codex subscription via device code OAuth.
- [Import Local Codex Credentials](docs/agent-native.md#step-4-authentication--credential-storage): Import local Codex CLI credentials from `~/.codex/credentials.json`.
- [Configure Multi-Account Pooling](docs/agent-native.md#pool-multiple-subscriptions-for-zero-downtime-rate-limits): Set up multiple subscriptions with automatic failover on rate limits.
- [Configure Cursor Adapter](docs/agent-native.md#step-3-initialization--configuration-generation): Ingress model rewriting and reasoning effort injection on port 8333.
- [Configure Devin Bridge](docs/agent-native.md#step-3-initialization--configuration-generation): ConnectRPC protobuf bridge to OpenAI on port 18473.
- [Configure Factory Droid](docs/agent-native.md#step-3-initialization--configuration-generation): Factory language-model translation on port 18474.
- [Configure Multi-Provider Gateway](docs/agent-native.md#step-3-initialization--configuration-generation): Universal gateway on port 8400 for OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini SDKs.
